 ADVERTISEMENT   Filtered By: Showbiz Showbiz PBB: Marian Rivera, Dingdong Dantes listen to stories that housemates want to forget, remember 
 By GMA News Published November 2, 2026 10:59pm 
 + Add GMA on Google Make this your preferred source to get more updates from this publisher on Google. Photo: Pinoy Big Brother Marian Rivera and Dingdong Dantes entered Bahay ni Kuya on Monday's episode of " Pinoy Big Brother: Collab Edition 3.0 ."
 The showbiz royalty arrived after the housemates did a challenge where they had to dress up as Marian's and Dingdong's past roles and copy their poses.
 The couple was also tasked by Kuya to lead the housemates in opening up about specific memories in their lives: those they would rather forget, and those whey want to remember.
 Some housemates shared painful memories, like Mikee Quintos ' regret about not spending time with her late grandmother days before she died. Others looked back on happier times, such as Ethan Benares on his last Christmas with his late grandfather.

 Marian and Dingdong are set to star in the upcoming movie " Remember ," where they play an estranged couple. They must navigate their daughter's illness, whose symptoms include memory loss.
 Directed by Mae Cruz-Alviar, the film will open cinemas on November 11.
 "PBB: Collab 3.0" premiered on Saturday. Sixteen housemates , composed of celebrity personalities, social media stars, and ordinary netizens, entered the new PBB house.
 The reality series airs on GMA Network from Mondays to Fridays at 9:35 p.m., Saturdays at 6:15 p.m., and Sundays at 4:45 p.m. —MGP, GMA News
